paper_title: Eine neue Orientierung für den Mindestlohn
caption: Entwicklung des gesetzlichen Mindestlohns und der tarifvertraglichen Stundenlöhne, 2015-2025
model_annotation: The diagram illustrates the development of the statutory minimum wage and contractual hourly wages from January 2015 to January 2025. The x-axis represents time, marked at six-month intervals from January 2015 to January 2025, while the y-axis represents the index value, ranging from 90 to 160 in increments of 10. The purple line, representing the statutory minimum wage indexed to January 2015 = 100, starts at 100 in January 2015 and remains steady until July 2015, then increases in steps to 102.2 in January 2016, 108.2 in January 2017, 111.8 in January 2018, 116.4 in January 2019, and 121.7 in January 2020, before rising more sharply to 122.7 in July 2020 and then to 145.7 in July 2022, and further increasing to 141.2 in October 2022 is not directly shown but is referenced in the legend, then it increases again. The light blue line, representing contractual hourly wages (excluding special payments) indexed to January 2015 = 100, begins at 100 in January 2015 and gradually increases to approximately 118.7 by January 2021. The dark blue line represents the same data but is indexed to October 2022 = 141.2, continuing from the light blue line's trend, showing a more pronounced increase starting from around January 2022, reaching approximately 153.7 by January 2025.
